description: This script automates the building and testing of Docker containers with Intel MKL support for TensorFlow, including functions for directory searching, Docker image building, testing, and tagging. It manages different platform configurations and supports build customization via environment variables.

methods.name: upsearch
methods.description: Recursively searches parent directories for a specific file or directory.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages if the DEBUG variable is set to 1.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: build_container
methods.description: Builds a Docker container with specified arguments, handling build arguments for proxy settings, platform configurations, and optional features.

methods.name: test_container
methods.description: Runs a container from the built image, performs health checks (such as MKL and horovod), and then stops it.

methods.name: checkout_tensorflow
methods.description: Clones and checks out a specific version or PR of the TensorFlow repository.

methods.name: tag_container
methods.description: Tags the built Docker image with the specified final image name.

search-terms: test container for MKL and horovod
